issues.problem: Story checked: 間不容髪 is from Mei Cheng's memorial to Liu Pi, King of Wu (上書諫呉王, in 漢書 枚乗伝 and 文選), with the image of a thread holding a heavy weight over an abyss. The details and the source are correct, and so is the kan-hatsu reading note.
Adversarial check against 右に出る者はいない, 一枚上手 and 桁が違う: the contexts use 群を抜いて + adjective and 群を抜いた + noun, which those idioms cannot fill.
Adversarial check against 隅に置けない (in the set): no context hinges on someone being more capable than they look.
Adversarial check against 板につく (in the set): the contexts stress repeated occasions (うちに慣れてきた, 何社か受けて, 場数を踏ませよう), which 板につく does not fit.
The surprise-party context (わざと蚊帳の外にされていた) is playful but natural. 影が薄い and 蚊帳の外 are told apart correctly in both near entries.
